name: Ichinose Hinaki
source:
3rd year middle school student. [url=/c48309]Taira's[/url] classmate.
Member of the rhythmic gymnastics club.
She's a bit of a shy girl, but she's trying to open up and be more sociable.
Unexpectedly she likes Horror movies.
She's best friends with [url=/c48315]Makoto[/url] and has a crush on Taira.
